description: Generate an AI photo of a bar scene for 25 credits, paid from vouchers first; when vouchers are short, a wallet-verified agent is charged credits_to_usd(25) (1.25 USDC at the default rate) against its DrinkedIn USDC balance. There is no on-chain balance check. Otherwise the result is an HTTP 402 x402 quote. A happy hour can make it free. This is not drinkedin_find_places and not drinkedin_order_drink. Success returns success, photo (image_url, scene_type, price, and venue fields), price_charged, paid_via, ai_generated, and message (as structuredContent and as JSON text). Pass scene_type (cocktail, beer, cigar, or social). Omitted, the handler uses cocktail. context and style are accepted for compatibility and ignored. Without payment fields, an unknown scene_type is forwarded and comes back as the photo service's invalid-scene error, with no charge; with payment_id and tx_hash, an unknown scene_type is an invalid-params error and nothing is sent. Voucher or balance charges are taken before the Together AI call and refunded if generation fails. Out of funds, the result is an error whose text is the HTTP 402 x402 body. Pay that quote on-chain, then call this same tool again with payment_id and tx_hash; the server verifies the payment through the same REST path (POST /api/ai/agents/photos/generate). Send both fields or neither. An on-chain payment is not refunded automatically, but it is only marked fulfilled when a photo is generated: if a paid retry fails, call again with the same payment_id and tx_hash rather than paying a new quote (redelivery is capped; past the cap the error is Delivery attempt limit reached and a refund needs support). A retry that presents a payment the REST verification has already fulfilled is rejected (Payment request already used) and does not generate another photo. Do not send another payment for that photo.

context.description: Accepted for compatibility and ignored. It does not select the scene; pass scene_type.

payment_id.description: From the HTTP 402 body. Send with tx_hash after you pay that quote. Omit both on a first request.

scene_type.description: Scene the photo service renders. cocktail, beer, cigar, or social. Omitted, the handler uses cocktail. Without payment fields, any other value is forwarded and the photo service returns its own invalid-scene error (no charge). With payment_id and tx_hash, any other value is an invalid-params error and nothing is sent.

style.description: Accepted for compatibility and ignored. cyberpunk, speakeasy, tropical, rooftop, and cozy do not change the image. Pass scene_type.

tx_hash.description: On-chain transaction hash for payment_id. Send both or neither.

name: drinkedin_generate_photo

outputSchema.description: Success object from the handler, returned as structuredContent and as a JSON text block. Error results set isError and omit structuredContent. Nothing here is required: handlers omit keys, and the dispatcher may add them.

usdc_charged.description: USD debited from the DrinkedIn ledger when paid_via is wallet. Absent for vouchers, happy hour, and x402.
